data.name: Era Lens of Ancestral Traces
data.detailed_description:
Era Lens of Ancestral Traces

(First-Person 2D Archaeological Photo Game)

Step into the shoes of a young archaeological intern and explore the origins of humankind through the lens of your camera. In Era Lens of Ancestral Traces, your mission is to unlock the secrets of human evolution by photographing relics scattered across time and space.

Game Play Features

  • Strategic Exploration
    Every shot is a puzzle. Players must think carefully about how to use limited camera functions to capture the perfect photo, adding both depth and strategy to the journey.

  • Narrative Collection
    Each photograph contributes to a larger picture—literally. Piece by piece, you’ll assemble a complete timeline of human evolution, turning your discoveries into a meaningful story and giving you a strong sense of accomplishment.

  • Functional Photography
    Photography isn’t just decoration—it’s the core mechanic. Simple controls make it easy to pick up, while the layered photo challenges keep the experience engaging and rewarding.

Your Journey

  • Start with simple snapshots and gradually gain access to advanced tools.

  • Explore diverse historical periods, from early hominids to Homo sapiens.

  • Complete challenges that reveal the timeline of human ancestry.

Key Details

  • Genre: Photo / Archaeology Adventure

  • Perspective: First-Person 2D

  • Core Loop: Explore → Photograph → Archive → Unlock New Tools

  • Theme: Human Evolution & Archaeological Discovery

data.short_description: This is a first-person 2D archaeological photo game. The player will play the role of a young archaeological intern. By unlocking various professional functions of the camera, he will take specific photos of human evolution relics and complete the human evolution file wall.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows® 8.1/10/11(64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows® 11(64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 590 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
